BikeVC Brew Ride

Ventura, CA · Westside · Social · Mixed

Beginner friendly

BikeVC Brew Ride is a social group ride in Ventura, CA. It rolls second Sunday of the month at 1:00 pm from Ventura Bike HUB. Pace: easy city pace. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 1:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy city pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bikevta the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the BikeVC Brew Ride group ride

A long-standing BikeVC tradition: an easy city ride from the community bike shop to a couple of Ventura breweries, done by about 4 pm. Runs spring, summer and fall, usually the second Sunday. Plans can change, so check the Meetup group.
